## Summary
Residents and businesses in Houston have multiple options for responsibly disposing of their electronic waste through secure and certified recycling services. One of the primary ways to recycle electronics is by visiting drop-off locations where you can directly deliver your items. The City of Houston provides a range of these sites through its Solid Waste Management Department, including accessible drop-off locations for residents.
